blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Humans exhibit diverse and expressive whole-body movements. However, attaining human-like whole-body coordination in humanoid robots remains challenging, as conventional approaches that mimic whole-body motions often neglect the distinct roles of upper and lower body. This oversight leads to computationally intensive policy learning and frequently causes robot instability and falls during real-world execution. To address these issues, we propose Adversarial Locomotion and Motion Imitation (ALMI), a novel framework that enables adversarial policy learning between upper and lower body. Specifically, the lower body aims to provide robust locomotion capabilities to follow velocity commands while the upper body tracks various motions. Conversely, the upper-body policy ensures effective motion tracking when the robot executes velocity-based movements. Through iterative updates, these policies achieve coordinated whole-body control, which can be extended to loco-manipulation tasks with teleoperation systems. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves robust locomotion and precise motion tracking in both simulation and on the full-size Unitree H1 robot. Additionally, we release a large-scale whole-body motion control dataset featuring high-quality episodic trajectories from MuJoCo simulations deployable on real robots. The project page is `https://almi-humanoid.github.io` .
blocks.zh: 人类展现出多样且富有表现力的全身运动。然而，在人形机器人上实现类人的全身协调仍极具挑战，因为传统的全身动作模仿方法往往忽略了上半身与下半身的不同分工。这一疏忽导致策略学习的计算开销巨大，并在真实世界执行过程中频繁引发机器人不稳定乃至摔倒。为解决这些问题，我们提出了对抗移动与动作模仿（Adversarial Locomotion and Motion Imitation, ALMI），这是一种在上半身与下半身之间进行对抗策略学习的新型框架。具体而言，下半身旨在提供强大的移动能力以跟踪速度指令，而上半身则跟踪各种动作。反之，上半身策略在机器人执行基于速度的移动时，仍能确保有效的动作跟踪。通过迭代更新，这些策略实现了协调的全身控制，并可通过遥操作系统扩展至移动操作任务。大量实验表明，我们的方法在仿真环境和全尺寸 Unitree H1 机器人上均实现了鲁棒的移动与精准的动作跟踪。此外，我们开源了一个大规模全身运动控制数据集，其中包含来自 MuJoCo 仿真、可直接部署于真实机器人的高质量分段轨迹（episodic trajectories）。项目主页为 `https://almi-humanoid.github.io`。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 1 引言

blocks.en: Humans exhibit diverse and expressive whole-body movements in various activities [1, 2]. For example, in dancing, humans depend on the lower body for stable movements and gait control, and the upper body executes precise actions to accomplish specific movements. This coordination allows for expressive and purposeful motions that are highly adaptable to different situations. However, achieving human-like whole-body coordination remains a highly challenging task for humanoid robots. Current methods employ motion re-targeting and Reinforcement Learning (RL) to learn a whole-body policy that can track human motions by taking the tracking errors as rewards and optimizing a whole-body policy to maximize such rewards [3, 4].
blocks.zh: 人类在各类活动中展现出丰富多样且富有表现力的全身运动 [1, 2]。例如在舞蹈中，人类依靠下半身实现稳定的移动与步态控制，同时由上半身执行精准动作以完成特定的姿态表达。这种协调配合使得动作既富有表现力又具目的性，并能高度适应不同情境。然而，对人形机器人而言，实现类人的全身协调仍是一项极具挑战性的任务。现有方法通常采用动作重定向（motion retargeting）与强化学习（RL），将跟踪误差作为奖励并优化全身策略以最大化该奖励，从而学习能够跟踪人体动作的全身控制策略 [3, 4]。

blocks.en: However, this kind of approach has significant limitations. First, due to the high number of Degrees of Freedom (DoF) in the humanoid robot, directly learning a whole-body control policy demands a complex reward structure and makes the training process highly expensive. Second, the differences between various motions, along with some human movements beyond a robot’s physical capabilities, make it difficult for the RL policy to converge. Meanwhile, the poor stability of the lower body in turn affects the execution of upper-body motion and reveals challenges in real-world deployment, such as frequent robot falls. We identify that the main reason is above methods does not separately consider the unique roles of the upper and lower bodies in motion learning, specifically, the lower body’s role in robust locomotion and the upper body’s task of precise motion imitation.
blocks.zh: 优先考虑精准的动作跟踪而非平衡维持，策略往往会忽略机器人稳定性的基本需求。同时，下半身较差的稳定性反过来又会影响上半身动作的执行，并在真实世界部署中暴露出诸多挑战，例如机器人频繁摔倒。我们发现，主要原因在于上述方法在动作学习中并未分别考虑上半身和下半身的独特分工——具体而言，即下半身负责鲁棒移动，而上半身承担精准动作模仿的任务。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose a novel framework, named Adversarial Locomotion and Motion Imitation ( ALMI ), that separately learns robust locomotion and motion imitation policies for the upper and lower bodies, respectively. Specifically, the lower body learns to follow different velocity commands while withstanding adversarial disturbances from the upper body, which leads to robust locomotion even when the upper-body movements significant disrupt the stability. Conversely, the upper body learns to track reference motions accurately despite adversarial disturbances caused by lower-body instability, which leads to expressive motion imitation even when the lower body is commanded to move rapidly over uneven terrain. Through iterative updates of the upper and lower policies, these policies achieve coordinated whole-body control, which can be extended to loco-manipulation tasks with open-loop upper-body control via teleoperation systems. Unlike recent works [5, 6] that adopt separate control for the upper and lower body, ALMI involves an adversarial training process to obtain coordinated behavior, which ensures the upper and lower policies converge to an equilibrium under mild conditions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ALMI achieves robust locomotion and precise motion tracking in both simulation and on a full-size Unitree H1-2 humanoid robot.
blocks.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个名为对抗移动与动作模仿（Adversarial Locomotion and Motion Imitation, ALMI）的新型框架，分别针对下半身和上半身单独学习鲁棒移动策略与动作模仿策略。具体而言，下半身在承受来自上半身对抗性扰动的同时学习遵循不同的速度指令，从而在上半身运动严重破坏稳定性的情况下仍能实现鲁棒移动。反之，上半身在承受由下半身不稳定引起的对抗性扰动的同时学习精准跟踪参考动作，从而在下半身受命在崎岖地形上快速移动时，仍能实现富有表现力的动作模仿。通过对上下半身策略的迭代更新，这些策略实现了协调的全身控制，并可通过遥操作系统配合开环上半身控制扩展至移动操作任务。与近期对上下半身采用分离控制的工作 [5, 6] 不同，ALMI 引入了对抗训练过程以获得协调行为，从而确保上下半身策略在温和条件下收敛至均衡。大量实验表明，ALMI 在仿真环境以及全尺寸 Unitree H1-2 人形机器人上均实现了鲁棒的移动与精准的动作跟踪。

blocks.en: Further, we construct a large-scale whole-body control dataset, named ALMI-X , featuring episodic trajectories for the Unitree H1-2 robot in MuJoCo simulations. Each episode is generated by the ALMI-acquired policy, where the lower body is controlled by the velocity command, and the higher body is controlled by joystick commands (i.e., desired joints) of the reference motion from the AMASS dataset [7]. We annotate language descriptions for each episode data according to both commands of the lower and upper bodies, e.g. moving backward slowly and wave the left hand . The ALMI-X dataset contains more than 80K trajectories with text commands and corresponding trajectories that can be deployed in real robots. We also give preliminary attempts to train a foundation model from the collected ALMI-X data, which serves an end-to-end whole-body control policy by leveraging a Transformer-based architecture.
blocks.zh: 此外，我们构建了一个名为 ALMI-X 的大规模全身控制数据集，其特点是包含 MuJoCo 仿真中 Unitree H1-2 机器人的分段轨迹。每个 episode 均由 ALMI 学得的策略生成，其中下半身由速度指令控制，上半身则由来自 AMASS 数据集 [7] 参考动作的手柄指令（即期望关节角）控制。我们根据上下半身的指令为每个 episode 数据标注了语言描述，例如“缓慢后退并挥动左手”（moving backward slowly and wave the left hand）。ALMI-X 数据集包含超过 8 万条带有文本指令及可部署到真实机器人上的相应轨迹。我们还初步尝试了利用收集的 ALMI-X 数据训练控制基座模型，借助基于 Transformer 的架构实现端到端的全身控制策略。

blocks.en: Our main contributions are summarized as follows: (i) We propose a novel adversarial training framework (ALMI) for robust locomotion and precise motion imitation for humanoid robots, addressing the distinct roles of upper and lower body through separate policy learning. (ii) We create the first large-scale whole-body control dataset (ALMI-X) that integrates language descriptions with robot trajectories, facilitating the training of foundation models for humanoid whole-body control. (iii) We conduct extensive experiments to verify the effectiveness of the ALMI policy and the preliminary study for the humanoid foundation control model in both the simulation and the real world.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献总结如下：(i) 我们提出了一种用于人形机器人鲁棒移动与精准动作模仿的新型对抗训练框架（ALMI），通过分离的策略学习兼顾了上半身与下半身的不同职责。(ii) 我们创建了首个将语言描述与机器人轨迹相结合的大规模全身控制数据集（ALMI-X），促进了面向人形机器人全身控制的基座模型训练。(iii) 我们进行了广泛的实验，在仿真与真实世界中均验证了 ALMI 策略的有效性，并对人形机器人基座控制模型进行了初步探索。

blocks.en: 2 Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 预备知识

blocks.en: In our work, we adopt an adversarial training framework for the policy learning of both the upper and lower bodies. Specifically, we consider an MDP M = ( S, Al , Au , T, γ, rl , ru , P ), where the lower and upper bodies share the same state space S while having different action space, that is, Al and Au , respectively. rl is the command-following reward for the locomotion policy (i.e., the lower body), and ru is the tracking reward for motion-imitation policy (i.e., the upper body). P ( s′ |s, al , au ) is the transition probability function that denotes the probability of transitioning to the next state s′ given the current state and the actions of both players. We aim to learn two policies, i.e., πl and πu , that control different actions for the lower and upper bodies, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在本文工作中，我们采用对抗训练框架来进行上半身和下半身的策略学习。具体而言，我们考虑一个马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）M = ( S, Al , Au , T, γ, rl , ru , P )，其中下半身与上半身共享相同的状态空间 S，但拥有不同的动作空间，分别记为 Al 和 Au。rl 是移动策略（即下半身）的指令跟踪奖励，ru 是动作模仿策略（即上半身）的跟踪奖励。P ( s′ |s, al , au ) 为状态转移概率函数，表示在给定当前状态以及博弈双方动作的前提下转移到下一状态 s′ 的概率。我们的目标是学习两个策略，即 πl 和 πu，分别控制下半身和上半身的不同动作。

blocks.en: We adopted the full-sized Unitree H1-2 robot in our work, which has 27 DoFs in total, and the policy controls 21 DoFs, excluding the 3 DoFs in each wrist of the hands. The state space is defined as s = ( sprop t , cl , ϕ t, gu ), where sprop t = [ q t, q ˙ t, ω t, gv t, al t− 1] is the proprioception of the robot, cl = [ˆ vx,t, ˆ vy,t, ˆ ω yaw ,t ] is the the velocity command for the lower-body, and ϕ t ∈ R2 is the phase parameter at each time step, and gu ∈ R9 is the reference joint position for the upper body. In proprioception, the notation q t ∈ R21 , q ˙ t ∈ R21 , ω t ∈ R3 , gv t ∈ R3 , al t− 1∈R12isthejoint position, the joint velocity, the angular velocity of the base, the projected gravity of the base, and the last action of the lower body, respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们在工作中采用了全尺寸 Unitree H1-2 机器人，该机器人共有 27 个自由度（DoF），策略控制其中的 21 个自由度（不包括双手手腕各自的 3 个自由度）。状态空间定义为 s = ( sprop t , cl , ϕ t, gu )，其中 sprop t = [ q t, q ˙ t, ω t, gv t, al t− 1] 为机器人的本体感受状态，cl = [ˆ vx,t, ˆ vy,t, ˆ ω yaw ,t ] 为下半身的速度指令，ϕ t ∈ R2 为每个时间步的相位参数，gu ∈ R9 为上半身的参考关节位置。在本体感受状态中，记号 q t ∈ R21、q ˙ t ∈ R21、ω t ∈ R3、gv t ∈ R3、al t− 1∈R12 分别表示关节位置、关节速度、基体角速度、基体投影重力以及下半身上一时刻的动作。

blocks.en: For the lower body, the policy πl gives an action al ∈ R12 representing target joint positions of the lower body according to the proprioception, commands, and phase variables at each step, which are fed into the PD controller to calculate the joint torques. For the upper body, policy πu takes proprioception and reference joint position as input, and the action al ∈ R9 includes target positions of the 3 shoulder joints and 1 elbow joint per arm, along with the waist yaw joint. As a result, the two policies ( πu and πl ) control distinct action spaces of the robot, and the sharing the same state space by masking the irrelevant commands for the different policy.
blocks.zh: 对于下半身，策略 πl 根据每个时间步的本体感受、指令和相位变量输出动作 al ∈ R12，代表下半身的目标关节位置，这些位置被输入到 PD 控制器中以计算关节力矩。对于上半身，策略 πu 接收本体感受和参考关节位置作为输入，其动作 al ∈ R9 包括每条手臂的 3 个肩关节和 1 个肘关节、以及腰部偏航（yaw）关节的目标位置。因此，这两个策略（πu 和 πl）控制着机器人互不重叠的动作空间，并通过为不同策略掩蔽无关指令来共享相同的状态空间。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: In this section, we first present the theoretical foundation for the adversarial learning framework, and then give practical algorithms for implementing such a framework for humanoid robots.
blocks.zh: 在本节中，我们首先介绍对抗学习框架的理论基础，随后给出在人形机器人上实现该框架的具体实用算法。

blocks.en: 3.2 Robust Locomotion for the Lower Body
blocks.zh: 3.2 下半身鲁棒运动

blocks.en: Achieving robust locomotion in humanoid robots remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the dynamic nature of environments and the inherent complexity of multi-joint floating base systems. This instability is particularly pronounced in full-sized humanoid robots, which often require increased load capacity to execute whole-body control or loco-manipulation tasks. Such requirements typically lead to higher arm mass and inertia, exacerbating system instability. Consequently, during coordinated upper and lower body movements or mobile manipulation, disturbances generated by the upper body exert significant impacts on the lower body, necessitating robust policies to mitigate these effects.
blocks.zh: 在人形机器人中实现鲁棒运动仍然是一项重大挑战，这主要是由于环境的动态特性以及多关节浮动基座系统固有的复杂性。这种不稳定性在全尺寸人形机器人中尤为明显，因为它们通常需要更大的负载能力来执行全身控制或移动操作任务。这些要求通常会导致手臂质量和惯性增加，从而加剧系统的不稳定性。因此，在上下半身协同运动或移动操作过程中，上半身产生的扰动会对下半身造成显著影响，这就需要具备鲁棒性的策略来减轻这些影响。

blocks.en: Motivation of Curriculum. In learning a robust locomotion policy, an adversarial upper body component is essential to generate perturbations. However, directly training such an adversary is challenging. Empirical results show that without constraints, the upper body can terminate episodes early or collide with the lower body to minimize its reward. Manually designing constraints is labor intensive, and the lower body can exploit flaws in the reward function, leading to poor real-world performance. Thus, as we discussed in §3.1, we simplify the original problem by sampling adversarial motions without updating the upper-body policy. Although aggressive sampling of highly dynamic motions can reduce the locomotion policy’s value function (i.e. Vl ) as in Eq. (2), this strategy cannot adequately teach the locomotion policy how to resist disturbances when the policy is relatively weak, resulting in slow convergence. To overcome this, we introduce a novel curriculum mechanism that starts with moderate disturbances and gradually increases their intensity as the lower body’s robustness improves, ensuring efficient learning and robustness improvement throughout training.
blocks.zh: 课程设计的动机。在学习鲁棒运动策略时，对抗性上半身模块对于产生扰动至关重要。然而，直接训练这样一个对抗模块极具挑战性。经验结果表明，在缺乏约束的情况下，上半身可能会通过提前终止回合或与下半身发生碰撞来最小化其奖励。人工设计约束费时费力，且下半身可能会利用奖励函数中的漏洞，导致较差的现实世界表现。因此，正如我们在 §3.1 中所讨论的，我们通过采样对抗性动作而不更新上半身策略来简化原始问题。尽管激进地采样高动态动作可以像式 (2) 中那样降低运动策略的价值函数（即 Vl ），但当该策略相对较弱时，这种策略无法充分教会运动策略如何抵御扰动，从而导致收敛缓慢。为了克服这一问题，我们引入了一种新颖的课程机制，该机制从中等强度的扰动开始，并随着下半身鲁棒性的提高逐步增加扰动强度，确保在整个训练过程中实现高效学习和鲁棒性提升。

blocks.en: 3.3 Motion Tracking for the Upper Body
blocks.zh: 3.3 上半身动作跟踪

blocks.en: The upper-body policy πu aims to track various motions under disturbances from lower-body movements with adversarial commands. Before motion tracking, we follow the process proposed by PHC [11] to re-target the human motion from AMASS [7] dataset to humanoid robot. To enhance motion smoothness, we applied low-pass filtering to the re-targeted motion data.
blocks.zh: 上半身策略 πu 旨在抵御来自具有对抗性指令的下半身运动所产生的扰动，并跟踪各种动作。在动作跟踪之前，我们遵循 PHC [11] 提出的流程，将来自 AMASS [7] 数据集的人体动作重定向到人形机器人上。为了增强动作的平滑度，我们对重定向后的动作数据应用了低通滤波。

blocks.en: In the adversarial training process, we use the locomotion policy πl in the current round to control the lower body, and the upper-body policy is learned by maximizing the motion tracking reward. Different from §3.2 that requires delicate curriculum mechanism, the curriculum for adversarial πl can be relatively simple since the command cl only contains velocity commands. Specifically, cl is sampled from a range of [ cl min,c maxl], and we adjust the value ofcl minandc maxlaccording to the tracking error or motions in the upper body, which is affected by the movement of the lower body. In training πu , the lower-body command gradually increase its difficulty based on the tracking error of the upper body. The detailed curriculum mechanism and reward design in learning the upper-body policy is given in Appendix B.3.
blocks.zh: 在对抗性训练过程中，我们使用当前轮次的运动策略 πl 来控制下半身，并通过最大化动作跟踪奖励来学习上半身策略。与 §3.2 中需要精细课程机制不同，对抗性 πl 的课程可以相对简单，因为指令 cl 仅包含速度指令。具体而言，cl 是从范围 [ cl min,c maxl] 中采样的，并且我们根据受下半身运动影响的上半身跟踪误差或动作来调整 cl min 和 c maxl 的取值。在训练 πu 时，下半身指令根据上半身的跟踪误差逐步增加其难度。学习上半身策略的详细课程机制和奖励设计在附录 B.3 中给出。

blocks.en: Foundation Model for Humanoid Control. Using ALMI-X dataset, a whole-body foundation model capable of executing various motions in response to text commands can be effectively trained through supervised learning. We adopt a Transformer decoder architecture that implements causal self-attention modules over a text command and historical state-action pairs. Unlike UH-1 [12] that predicts the entire action sequence based on the text command, our policy autoregressively models the next action by incorporating real-time interaction history between the robot and the environment. This architecture avoids executing the entire action sequence without considering the random noise and interference of the environment, instead adjusting actions based on intermediate states, ensuring robust and adaptive control. Moreover, compared to methods focused solely on walking [13], ALMIX contains more diverse data from various motions and velocity commands, enabling the learning of the foundation model to achieve complex language-guided whole body control. The architecture is shown in Fig. 2 and the details are given in Appendix D.
blocks.zh: 用于人形机器人控制的基础模型。利用 ALMI-X 数据集，可以通过监督学习有效训练出一个能够响应文本指令执行各种动作的全身基础模型。我们采用 Transformer 解码器架构，在文本指令和历史状态-动作对上实现因果自注意力模块。与根据文本指令预测整个动作序列的 UH-1 [12] 不同，我们的策略通过结合机器人与环境之间的实时交互历史，自回归地建模下一个动作。该架构避免了在不考虑环境随机噪声和干扰的情况下直接执行整个动作序列，而是根据中间状态调整动作，从而确保了鲁棒且自适应的控制。此外，与仅关注行走的方法 [13] 相比，ALMI-X 包含来自各种动作和速度指令的更多样化数据，使得基础模型能够学习实现复杂的语言引导全身控制。该架构如图 2 所示，具体细节在附录 D 中给出。

blocks.en: 5 Related Works
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Humanoid Locomotion. Traditional humanoid locomotion primarily focuses on trajectory planning [14, 15] and Zero-Moment Point (ZMP)-based gait synthesis [16, 17]. Other methods like wholebody control [18, 19] and model-predictive control [20, 21] gain significant progress with dynamics modeling, while it can be difficult to model rich contact in complex terrains [22]. Recently, learningbased algorithms have shown promising results in humanoid locomotion tasks [23, 24]. RL has become a powerful tool for learning locomotion policies by enabling agents to interact with the environment through parallelized simulations [25]. Based on this, humanoids can acquire a wide range of skills, including walking on complex terrains [26], gait control [27], standing up [28, 29], narrow-terrain navigation [30], jumping [31], and even parkour [32, 33]. However, most methods focus solely on controlling the lower-body joints, treating the upper body as a fixed load [34, 35]. Although some studies have explored whole-body control policies [30, 27], their primary objective
blocks.zh: 人形机器人移动。传统的人形机器人移动主要侧重于轨迹规划 [14, 15] 以及基于零力矩点（ZMP）的步态生成 [16, 17]。全身控制 [18, 19] 和模型预测控制 [20, 21] 等其他方法通过动力学建模取得了显著进展，但在复杂地形中对丰富的接触进行建模可能很困难 [22]。近年来，基于学习的算法在人形机器人移动任务中展现出广阔的前景 [23, 24]。强化学习（RL）通过并行化仿真让智能体与环境交互 [25]，已成为学习移动策略的强大工具。在此基础上，人形机器人可以习得广泛的技能，包括在复杂地形上行走 [26]、步态控制 [27]、起立 [28, 29]、狭窄地形导航 [30]、跳跃 [31] 乃至跑酷 [32, 33]。然而，大多数方法仅关注于控制下半身关节，将上半身视为固定负载 [34, 35]。尽管一些研究探索了全身控制策略 [30, 27]，但它们的主要目标

blocks.en: is to learn an upper-body swinging policy to coordinate with the locomotion task. In contrast, our method enables the lower-body policy to resist disturbances caused by various upper-body motions.
blocks.zh: 是学习一种上半身摆动策略以协同移动任务。相比之下，我们的方法使下半身策略能够抵御由各种上半身动作所引起的扰动。

blocks.en: Humanoid Motion Imitation. Recent research has proposed expressive motion imitation algorithms that learn human-like behaviors from motion capture datasets [36–38]. These methods employ motion re-targeting and RL-based optimization to achieve fine-grained motion imitation and postural stability [39–41]. However, balancing these two objectives can be challenging, as the execution of motions may disturb stability, while poor stability, in turn, affects the precision of motion execution. Several methods address this issue through careful reward design [42, 43], decomposed tracking strategies [6, 4], and residual learning [44]. Unlike these methods, our approach focuses solely on tracking human motions in the upper body. Although this may result in less expressiveness, it leads to robust locomotion in the lower body and precise motion tracking in the upper body, leading to an effective whole-body policy for real-world deployment. Other methods [45, 46, 5] also adopt a separate control paradigm fo training the two parts with different rewards, while we employ an adversarial training process to promote coordinated behaviors between locomotion and motion imitation policies.
blocks.zh: 人形机器人动作模仿。近期的研究提出了富有表现力的动作模仿算法，从动作捕捉数据集 [36–38] 中学习类人行为。这些方法采用动作重定向和基于强化学习（RL）的优化来实现细粒度的动作模仿与姿态稳定性 [39–41]。然而，平衡这两个目标可能具有挑战性，因为动作的执行可能会干扰稳定性，而较差的稳定性反过来又会影响动作执行的精度。有几种方法通过精心设计的奖励函数 [42, 43]、分解跟踪策略 [6, 4] 以及残差学习 [44] 来解决这一问题。与这些方法不同，我们的方法仅专注于在上半身跟踪人体动作。尽管这可能会降低表现力，但它能实现下半身的鲁棒移动以及上半身的精确动作跟踪，从而产生适用于真实世界部署的有效全身策略。其他方法 [45, 46, 5] 也采用了分离控制范式，用不同的奖励来训练这两个部分，而我们则采用对抗性训练过程来促进移动策略与动作模仿策略之间的协调行为。

blocks.en: Foundation Model for Robotics. Our work is also related to the learning of foundation models for robotics. Previous works mainly focus on building vision-language-action models for end-to-end manipulation, such as MT-Diff [47], RT-1 [48], Octo [49], OpenVLA [50], RDT [51], π 0 [52], GO-1 [53], and BRS [54]. They rely on large-scale datasets collected by humans, such as RH20T [55], Bridge Data [56], RoboMIND [57], Open-X [58], and AgiBot Data [53]. However, these datasets focus mainly on arm manipulation with a fixed or wheeled platform. In contrast, our dataset (i.e., ALMI-X) targets whole-body control in humanoid robots, which involves controlling more DoFs than manipulation tasks. UH-1 [12] is closely related to ALMI, but learns a mapping from text descriptions to keypoints, and low-level actions are found to be unexecutable in real robots.
blocks.zh: 机器人基础模型。我们的工作还与用于机器人领域的基础模型学习相关。以往的工作主要侧重于构建用于端到端操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，例如 MT-Diff [47]、RT-1 [48]、Octo [49]、OpenVLA [50]、RDT [51]、π 0 [52]、GO-1 [53] 以及 BRS [54]。它们依赖于人类采集的大规模数据集，例如 RH20T [55]、Bridge Data [56]、RoboMIND [57]、Open-X [58] 和 AgiBot Data [53]。然而，这些数据集主要集中于基于固定基座或轮式平台的手臂操作。相比之下，我们的数据集（即 ALMI-X）针对的是人形机器人的全身控制，这比操作任务涉及控制更多的自由度（DoF）。UH-1 [12] 与 ALMI 密切相关，但它学习的是从文本描述到关键点的映射，且其低层动作被发现在真实机器人上无法执行。

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6 实验

blocks.en: In this section, we evaluate the performance of ALMI using the Unitree H1-2 robot in both simulated and real-world environments. Our experiments aim to address the following research questions: Q1. How does ALMI perform in terms of tracking precision for lower-body velocity commands and upper-body motions? Q2. How does ALMI perform regarding stability and robustness in complex scenarios? Q3. What benefits does adversarial iterative training and the arm curriculum mechanism provide for policy optimization? Q4. How does ALMI perform in the real world ?
blocks.zh: 在本节中，我们在仿真和真实世界环境中利用 Unitree H1-2 机器人评估 ALMI 的性能。我们的实验旨在解决以下研究问题：Q1. ALMI 在下半身速度指令和上半身动作的跟踪精度方面表现如何？Q2. ALMI 在复杂场景下的稳定性和鲁棒性表现如何？Q3. 对抗性迭代训练与手臂课程机制能为策略优化带来哪些优势？Q4. ALMI 在真实世界中的表现如何？

blocks.en: Training Details. Policy training is conducted within the Isaac Gym simulator utilizing 4,096 parallel environments. We perform three rounds of adversarial iterations and evaluate the policies of the final round. Notably, during the adversarial iterative training process, the initial lower-body policy converges after approximately 104 steps. As iterations progress, the number of steps required for convergence decreases significantly. To enhance generalization, we implement domain randomization for sim-to-sim and sim-to-real transfers, with specific details provided in Appendix B.5.
blocks.zh: 训练细节。策略训练在 Isaac Gym 仿真器中进行，使用了 4,096 个并行环境。我们执行了三轮对抗迭代，并对最后一轮的策略进行评估。值得注意的是，在对抗性迭代训练过程中，初始下半身策略大约在 104 步后收敛。随着迭代的推进，收敛所需的步数显著减少。为了提升泛化能力，我们针对仿真到仿真（sim-to-sim）和仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real）实施了域随机化，具体细节见附录 B.5。

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics. For simulated evaluation, we adopt the high-quality CMU dataset [59] with 1122 motion clips (denoted as D cmu) to evaluate different metrics in IsaacGym [25]. The metrics include (i) the mean linear velocity error E vel(m / s) and the mean angular velocity error E ang(rad / s) that evaluate the command tracking accuracy; (ii) the joints position error E jpeupper (m) and upper body key points error E kpeupper (m) that evaluates the motion tracking accuracy; (iii) the joint difference for both parts E actionupper(rad),E actionlower(rad); (iv) and theprojected gravity Egevaluate the stability of policy. (v) We also statistically analyze survival rate to assess the robustness of the policy.
blocks.zh: 评估指标。在仿真评估中，我们采用包含 1122 个动作片段的高质量 CMU 数据集 [59]（记为 D cmu），在 IsaacGym [25] 中评估各项指标。这些指标包括：(i) 用于评估指令跟踪精度的平均线速度误差 E vel(m / s) 与平均角速度误差 E ang(rad / s)；(ii) 用于评估动作跟踪精度的关节位置误差 E jpeupper (m) 与上半身关键点误差 E kpeupper (m)；(iii) 两部分的关节差异 E actionupper(rad)、E actionlower(rad)；(iv) 以及用于评估策略稳定性的投影重力误差 Eg。(v) 我们还统计分析了存活率，以评估策略的鲁棒性。

blocks.en: Baselines. Our baselines are as follows: (i) Exbody [6], which employs a unified policy to control whole-body joints, tracking upper-body movements from motion data and lower-body root motion via command sampling. (ii) ALMI (whole) , which uses a single policy to control the upper and lower bodies, with identical reward functions for training each part as in ALMI. (iii) ALMI (w/o curriculum) . An ablation study that omits the arm curriculum, where the policy loads the motion randomly and the motion scale αs is set to 1. (iv) ALMI (w/o adv. learning) . This study evaluates the impact of our iterative adversarial training by testing policies from the first and second rounds.
blocks.zh: 基线方法。我们的基线方法如下：(i) Exbody [6]，该方法采用统一策略控制全身关节，通过动作数据跟踪上半身运动，并通过指令采样跟踪下半身根节点运动。(ii) ALMI (whole)，使用单一策略控制上半身和下半身，各部分训练采用与 ALMI 相同的奖励函数。(iii) ALMI (w/o curriculum)，去除了手臂课程的消融研究，其中策略随机加载动作，且动作尺度 αs 设为 1。(iv) ALMI (w/o adv. learning)，该消融研究通过测试第一轮和第二轮的策略，以评估我们迭代对抗训练的影响。

blocks.zh: 6.1 ALMI 的主要结果

blocks.zh: 于其他基线方法。结果表明，单一策略难以兼顾上下半身协调，从而限制了跟踪精度。相比之下，我们的对抗训练框架能针对两者的各自目标，同时提高两个策略的精度。(ii) 稳定性与鲁棒性。从存活率可以看出，随着难度级别的提升，ALMI 能够鲁棒地跟踪动作与速度指令，并有效防止跌倒。这种稳定性归功于下半身策略，它在受到对抗性上半身干扰的情况下，依然有效学会了执行稳定的动作，凸显了对抗训练策略的有效性。

blocks.en: To answer Q3 , we evaluate the impact of our arm curriculum and adversarial learning techniques, with results presented in Table 3. We use the trained lower-body policies across three iterations, labeled lower-1 , lower-2 , and lower-3 . Under easy velocity commands without environmental disturbances, performance differences among the iterations are minimal. However, as task complexity increased, lower-3 demonstrated superior performance across all metrics compared to earlier iterations, while lower-1 showed notably inferior results. During adversarial training, the lower and upper policies iteratively refined their motion and command tracking capabilities while generating progressively larger disturbances for each other, guided by the designed curriculum. For instance, to achieve high-velocity commands, the lower body might execute large-amplitude actions, inducing oscillations that disrupt upper-body movements, and vice versa. Through this iterative process, both policies gradually adapt to adversarial perturbations, eventually reaching a stable condition. In addition, Table 3 underscores the critical role of the arm curriculum. By systematically introducing upper-body motions from easy to hard in training, the lower-body policy effectively learned to handle increasingly difficult perturbations and motion scales.
blocks.zh: 为了回答 Q3，我们评估了手臂课程和对抗学习技术的影响，结果如表 3 所示。我们使用了经过三次迭代训练的下半身策略，分别标记为 lower-1、lower-2 和 lower-3。在没有环境扰动的简单速度指令下，各次迭代之间的性能差异极小。然而，随着任务复杂度的增加，与较早的迭代相比，lower-3 在所有指标上均展现出优异的性能，而 lower-1 的表现则明显较差。在对抗训练中，在所设计课程的引导下，下半身和上半身策略在迭代优化各自动作与指令跟踪能力的同时，相互产生逐渐增大的扰动。例如，为了达到高速度指令，下半身可能会执行大幅度动作，从而引发干扰上半身运动的振动，反之亦然。通过这一迭代过程，两种策略逐渐适应对抗性扰动，最终达到稳定状态。此外，表 3 强调了手臂课程的关键作用。通过在训练中系统地由易到难引入上半身动作，下半身策略有效地学会了应对日益困难的扰动和动作尺度。

blocks.en: 6.3 Real-World Experiments
blocks.zh: 6.3 真实世界实验

blocks.en: To answer Q4 , we deploy ALMI on the Unitree H1-2 robot to evaluate real-world performance. For lower-body control, we use a joystick-mounted remote controller to send velocity commands to πl , which controls the robot to achieve omnidirectional movement. For upper body control, we can adopt open-loop controller or ALMI policy to track various motions, as well as using VR devices to support dexterous control in loco-manipulation tasks. The details are given in Appendix E.
blocks.zh: 为了回答 Q4，我们将 ALMI 部署在 Unitree H1-2 机器人上以评估真实世界性能。对于下半身控制，我们使用带摇杆的遥控器向 πl 发送速度指令，由其控制机器人实现全向移动。对于上半身控制，我们可以采用开环控制器或 ALMI 策略来跟踪各种动作，并可以使用 VR 设备支持移动操作任务中的灵巧控制。详细信息见附录 E。

blocks.en: To evaluate the capabilities in maintaining stability in movements while tracking motions precisely, we control the robot to execute various upper body motions while standing or walking in omnidirection. Fig. 3 illustrates the motion tracking behavior, emphasizing the alignment between simulation and real-world performance. To further demonstrate the robot’s capability to perform complex motions during locomotion, Fig. 8 in the appendix provides a sim-to-real comparison of the robot completing a full motion sequence while moving forward and recovering to a standing position. These experiments confirm that ALMI enables the real robot to achieve robust locomotion and accurate motion tracking.
blocks.zh: 为了评估在精准跟踪动作的同时保持运动稳定性的能力，我们控制机器人在站立或全向行走时执行各种上半身动作。图 3 展示了动作跟踪行为，突出了仿真与真实世界表现的一致性。为了进一步展示机器人在移动过程中执行复杂动作的能力，附录中的图 8 提供了机器人在向前移动并恢复至站立姿势的过程中完成完整动作序列的仿真到现实迁移对比。这些实验证实了 ALMI 能够使真实机器人实现鲁棒的移动与精准的动作跟踪。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented ALMI, an adversarial training framework for humanoid whole-body control. ALMI leverages the designed curriculum for upper and lower body training, achieving stable locomotion and precise motion imitation through iterative policy updates. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates ALMI’s effectiveness within a two-player Markov game framework, supported by practical algorithms for implementation. The learned policy is used to collect the ALMI-X dataset with language annotations, facilitating foundation model training for the research community. Empirical results highlight ALMI’s superior performance in both simulated environments and real-world deployments. Future works include enhancing whole-body coordination through unified task-oriented rewards and improving the foundation model using advanced model architectures.
blocks.zh: 本文提出了 ALMI，一种用于人形机器人全身控制的对抗训练框架。ALMI 利用为上半身和下半身训练设计的课程，通过迭代策略更新实现了稳定的步态运动和精准的动作模仿。我们的理论分析在两人马尔可夫博弈框架内证明了 ALMI 的有效性，并由可落地的实用算法提供支持。训练得到的策略用于采集带有语言注释的 ALMI-X 数据集，为研究界的基础模型训练提供了便利。实证结果凸显了 ALMI 在仿真环境与真实世界部署中的卓越性能。未来的工作包括通过统一的任务导向奖励来增强全身协调性，以及使用先进的模型架构改进基础模型。

blocks.zh: B.2 运动策略的训练细节

blocks.en: Algorithm Description We employ PPO to train the locomotion policy, which consists of two key components: the policy and the environment. Trajectories are generated by deploying the policy on the robot within the environment, and the collected data is then used to update the policy. Additionally, the curriculum factors are used to adjust at the end of each episode. The algorithmic description is given in Algorithm 1.
blocks.zh: 算法描述 我们采用 PPO 来训练运动策略，该过程包含两个关键组成部分：策略与环境。通过在环境中将策略部署于机器人来生成轨迹，并利用收集到的数据更新策略。此外，课程因子会在每个回合结束时进行调整。算法描述见算法 1。

where f, d t , ψ are gait frequency, time step and gait offset, respectively. We use PPO to train the policy and employ an asymmetric actor-critic architecture, where the critic is granted access to the base linear velocity v t as privileged information. In subsequent iterations, we employ the trained upper-body policy as the upper-body controller.

B.3 Training Detail of the Motion-Tracking Policy

blocks.en: Algorithm Description During the training of the upper-body motion tracking policy, we use the pre-trained lower-body policy πl to execute the locomotion command and simultaneously introduce disturbance to the upper-body. We begin by sampling the locomotion velocity commands from a narrow range and compute the tracking error of the motion-tracking task. At each episode termination, if the tracking error is smaller than a threshold, the command sampling range will be extended to generate more intensive disturbance to the upper-body. We use PPO to train the motion tracking policy to simply follow the refenence DoF position

Dataset Overview The ALMI-X dataset contains 1989 motions combined with 41 commands, resulting 81,549 trajectories totally. Each trajectory is organized as τ = {τst, τ t a, τ t dofpos, τ t trans, τ t rot} tT =1, respectively representing robot states, actions, joint angles, global position and global orientation, where the global position and global orientation are usually considered as privilege information that is missing in the state space. The statistical results shown in Fig. 4, Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 demonstrate the advantages of ALMI-X, and the experimental results of Appendix D further indicate that our dataset is higher quality and more suitable for foundation model training. The dataset is released at `https://huggingface.co/datasets/TeleEmbodied/ALMI-X` .
blocks.zh: 数据集概览 ALMI-X 数据集包含 1989 个动作，并与 41 种指令相结合，总共生成了 81,549 条轨迹。每条轨迹组织为〔行内公式见原版〕，分别表示机器人状态、动作、关节角度、全局位置和全局朝向，其中全局位置和全局朝向通常被视为状态空间中缺失的特权信息。Fig. 4、Fig. 5 和 Fig. 6 中展示的统计结果证明了 ALMI-X 的优势，附录 D 的实验结果进一步表明我们的数据集质量更高，更适合基础模型训练。该数据集已在 `https://huggingface.co/datasets/TeleEmbodied/ALMI-X` 开源发布。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we classify the motions into 30 categories based on their corresponding texts. Then we count the number of steps in each category and augment those with fewer steps by repeating their motion sequences multiple times during data collection. This is not equivalent to mere data duplication, since environmental interactions cause the robot to produce slightly different trajectories each time, despite following the same reference motion. After that, the data volume across all categories is approximately the same, as shown in Fig. 4.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们根据对应的文本将动作划分为 30 个类别。随后，我们统计每个类别中的步数，并通过在数据收集过程中多次重复其动作序列，来对步数较少的类别进行增强。这并不等同于单纯的数据复制，因为即使遵循相同的参考动作，环境交互也会使机器人每次产生略微不同的轨迹。在此之后，所有类别的数据量大致相同，如 Fig. 4 所示。

blocks.en: After data augmentation, we obtain a total of 1,989 motions. When combined with different direction and difficulty commands, these motions generate a total of 81,549 trajectory sequences. Fig. 5 shows the planar position of all steps in space. The visualization result shows that despite the accumulated errors from the policy and the limitations of the simulator, the robot is still able to execute velocity commands in a reasonably correct manner. For instance, under the ‘go forward’ command, the steps are distributed along the positive x-axis, enabling the foundation model to learn representations across the space.
blocks.zh: 经过数据增强后，我们总共获得了 1,989 个动作。当与不同的方向和难度指令相结合时，这些动作共生成了 81,549 条轨迹序列。Fig. 5 展示了空间中所有步骤的平面位置。可视化结果表明，尽管存在来自策略的累积误差以及仿真器的局限性，机器人仍然能够以合理正确的方式执行速度指令。例如，在“向前走”指令下，各步骤沿 x 轴正向分布，使基础模型能够学习跨空间的表征。

blocks.en: Comparison to Humanoid-X [12] data Compared to the existing text-to-action dataset, Humanoid-X [12], our dataset exhibits much higher quality, which can be utilized for relatively stable open-loop control of the robot in simulations without causing the robot to lose control. This is because the RL policy that UH-1 employs to track motions have complex sources and can introduce dangerous or unreasonable behavior. However, due to the robust lower-body policy and expressive upper-body policy obtained through adversarial and curriculum learning, our collected ALMI-X dataset exhibits high executability. This attribute benefits the learning of the robot foundation model via a supervised learning paradigm, since the learned model would be better for deployment and also ensures safety in the real robot.
blocks.zh: 与 Humanoid-X [12] 数据的比较 相比于现有的文本到动作数据集 Humanoid-X [12]，我们的数据集展现出高得多的质量，可在仿真中用于机器人相对稳定的开环控制而不会导致机器人失控。这是因为 UH-1 用来跟踪动作的强化学习策略来源复杂，可能会引入危险或不合理的行为。然而，得益于通过对抗学习和课程学习所获得的鲁棒下半身策略以及富有表现力的上半身策略，我们收集的 ALMI-X 数据集展现出高度的可执行性。这一特性有利于通过监督学习范式来学习机器人基础模型，因为训练出的模型更易于部署，并能确保在真实机器人上的安全性。

We use CLIP [69] and a linear layer process the language description T into a vector of the same dimension x text = `Linear` ( `CLIP` ( T )) These vectors serve as input to the transformer decoder, which predicts the subsequent actions corresponding to each input. Model Inference In inference, the input text vector t text remains constant throughout the execution of the task. The robot executes the action decoded from the last vectors of the policy output. It is then concatenated with the newly acquired state, which is then computed into an embedding vector and serve as the last vector of the input for the policy to predict the next action. In the initial stage, when the length h of the historical state-action pairs is less than H , the robot will execute the action decoded using the vector corresponding to the latest state-action pair rather than the last one.
blocks.zh: 模型推理 在推理阶段，输入文本向量 t text 在整个任务执行过程中保持不变。机器人执行从策略输出的最后一个向量解码得到的动作。随后该动作与新获取的状态进行拼接，计算为一个嵌入向量，并作为策略输入的最后一个向量以预测下一个动作。在初始阶段，当历史状态-动作对的长度 h 小于 H 时，机器人将执行利用与最新状态-动作对相对应的向量解码得到的动作，而不是最后一个向量。

blocks.en: Implementation Details We investigated multiple designs for language-guided whole-body humanoid control through supervised learning using the ALMI-X dataset. We evaluate the Transformer architecture with different input sequence lengths for the closed-loop robot control approach, while also exploring the open-loop control approach of prediction and execution of the entire sequence with a tokenizer like UH-1 [12]. Specifically, the Transformer is trained with different state-action sequence lengths. We selected 20 and 400 as the input sequence lengths for the closed-loop control, while the open-loop control approach predicts the entire motion sequence with a maximum sequence length of 700 (175 after tokenization). For a shorter sequence, we expect the model to focus more on short-term historical information, allowing more robust locomotion performance. As for the longer sequence, we aim to integrate information from complete motion sequences in modeling, thereby better responding to text commands. For tokenization, we employ the same VQ-VAE [70] architecture as in T2M-GPT [71] to tokenize four state-action pairs into one token; while for the non-tokenized design, we utilize a linear layer to project both the text command feature and state-action pairs into a shared latent space.
blocks.zh: 实现细节 我们利用 ALMI-X 数据集，通过监督学习研究了语言引导的人形机器人全身控制的多种设计。针对闭环机器人控制方法，我们评估了具有不同输入序列长度的 Transformer 架构，同时也探索了类似于 UH-1 [12] 使用分词器（tokenizer）对整个序列进行预测与执行的开环控制方法。具体而言，Transformer 采用不同的状态-动作序列长度进行训练。对于闭环控制，我们选择 20 和 400 作为输入序列长度；而开环控制方法则预测整个动作序列，最大序列长度为 700（经分词后为 175）。对于较短的序列，我们期望模型更加关注短期历史信息，从而实现更鲁棒的运动性能。至于较长的序列，我们的目标是在建模中整合来自完整动作序列的信息，从而更好地响应文本指令。对于分词，我们采用与 T2M-GPT [71] 相同的 VQ-VAE [70] 架构，将四个状态-动作对编码为一个 token；而对于未分词的设计，我们使用一个线性层将文本指令特征和状态-动作对投影到一个共享的潜在空间中。

blocks.en: Evaluation Metrics Since training a foundation model to follow all text commands in ALMI-X is quite challenging, we conduct preliminary investigations using only wave-relative motion. We evaluate the models using different control approaches and input sequence lengths with different text commands in MuJoCo simulation, repeating each command 5 times with each test lasting 8 seconds. we adopt the following notation: CL − x sl denotes the closed-loop control approach without tokenization, where x represents the input sequence length (e.g., CL − 20sl). OL indicates the open-loop control approach with tokenization, which predicts and executes the entire motion sequence in a single forward pass. We evaluated several metrics, including robot survival time (up to 8 seconds), velocity during test time, and success rate of lower-body and upper-body. We consider the lower-body successful if the robot’s movement direction matches the text command, and the upper-body successful if the robot waves the correct hand.
blocks.zh: 评估指标 由于训练一个遵循 ALMI-X 中所有文本指令的基础模型极具挑战性，我们仅使用与挥手相关的动作进行初步探究。我们在 MuJoCo 仿真中使用不同的文本指令，对采用不同控制方法和输入序列长度的模型进行评估，每个指令重复 5 次，每次测试持续 8 秒。我们采用以下记号：CL − x sl 表示未分词的闭环控制方法，其中 x 代表输入序列长度（例如 CL − 20sl）。OL 表示进行了分词的开环控制方法，该方法在单次前向传播中预测并执行整个动作序列。我们评估了多项指标，包括机器人存活时间（最长 8 秒）、测试期间的速度，以及下半身和上半身的成功率。如果机器人的运动方向与文本指令相匹配，我们认为下半身成功；如果机器人挥动了正确的手，则认为上半身成功。

blocks.en: Experiment Results Results in Table 12 demonstrate that the open-loop control approach, which predicts and executes the entire action sequence based on a single text command, fails to maintain the robot’s balance and leads to an extremely low survival time. In contrast, the closed-loop control method exhibits more robust locomotion and superior lower-body text-following performance. Table 11 demonstrates that the closed-loop approach with a short input sequence length enables robot’s movement direction adapts to commands such as forward and right and its velocity adjusts to modifiers like fast and slowly , aligning more accurately with the sampled velocity commands as shown in Table 10. However, the approach with a longer sequence length results in poorer lower-body motion performance in both movement direction and velocity. blocks.en: Hardware and Deployment We conduct experiments using the Unitree-H1-2 robot equipped with the ROBOTERA XHAND robotic hand, applying ALMI-trained policies to the lower body control and various interfaces (i.e., open-loop controller, ALMI policy, and VR device) for the upper body control, as shown in Fig. 7. Specifically, (i) we can use an open-loop controller that sends the target joint positions of the pre-loaded motions; (ii) we can obtain actions of the upper body via the policy πu , which uses the reference joint positions of the preloaded motion as input. In real-world experiments, we find that open-loop control has higher tracking accuracy when the robot remains standing, but the learned policy shows better stability during movement. (iii) The other one is combining with teleoperation systems, which enable the robot to perform loco-manipulation tasks. Specifically, the upper-body follows wrist poses of humans and the relative positions between the robot end-effectors and the robot head are expected to match those between the human wrists and head, then the arm actions are obtained from inverse kinematics. The finger movements are also captured by VR simultaneously to control the dexterous hands for loco-manipulation tasks. Benefiting from the superiority of the training method and the use of domain randomization, our policy does not require additional sim-to-real techniques and can be deployed directly on the NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX onboard the robot for inference. The action output frequency of the policy is 50Hz.
blocks.zh: 硬件与部署 如图 7 所示，我们使用配备了 ROBOTERA XHAND 机械手的 Unitree-H1-2 机器人进行实验，将 ALMI 训练的策略应用于下半身控制，并使用多种接口（即开环控制器、ALMI 策略和 VR 设备）进行上半身控制。具体而言：(i) 我们可以使用开环控制器发送预加载动作的目标关节位置；(ii) 我们可以通过策略 πu 获取上半身的动作，该策略以预加载动作的参考关节位置作为输入。在真实世界实验中，我们发现当机器人保持站立时，开环控制具有更高的跟踪精度，但学习到的策略在移动过程中表现出更好的稳定性。(iii) 另一种方式是与遥操作系统相结合，使机器人能够执行移动操作（loco-manipulation）任务。具体来说，上半身跟随人类的手腕姿态，且机器人末端执行器与机器人头部之间的相对位置应与人类手腕和头部之间的相对位置相匹配，然后通过逆运动学计算获得手臂动作。手指运动也由 VR 同步捕获，以控制灵巧手执行移动操作任务。得益于训练方法的优越性以及域随机化的使用，我们的策略不需要额外的仿真到现实迁移（sim-to-real）技术，可以直接部署在机器人机载的 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上进行推理。该策略的动作输出频率为 50Hz。
